day-parts.title: maten and aswè
day-parts.bodyMarkdown:
Two useful everyday time words are:

- **maten** — morning
- **aswè** — evening

The source materials use expressions such as **Lendi maten** and questions about what people eat **aswè**.

today-now.title: jòdi a and kounyeya
today-now.bodyMarkdown:
Use:

- **jòdi a** — today
- **kounyeya** — now

You have already seen **kounyeya** with actions happening now. **Jòdi a** places something in the current day.

tomorrow-routine.title: denmen maten and chak jou
tomorrow-routine.bodyMarkdown:
Useful everyday expressions include:

- **denmen maten** — tomorrow morning
- **chak jou** — every day

These phrases help you talk about a simple schedule without needing advanced tense grammar.
